objective: Test whether the exact hash-pinned Generation 4 Yahoo adjusted-close panel is concordant with fresh authenticated Alpaca IEX daily adjustment=all data for all 20 CORE_SYMBOLS and every eligible Generation 5 candidate. Alpaca adjustment=split is diagnostic only. This package may not alter or rescue any Generation 4 artifact.
claim_boundary: This v2 protocol was designed after the Generation 4 source-reconciliation FAIL_CLOSED result and all quantitative outcomes through Generation 4 were observed. It compares already-seen, retrospectively revised history. A pass is source-concordance evidence only, not fresh out-of-sample evidence, independent alpha, future-profit evidence, or permission for live capital.

generation4_lock.immutability: No Generation 4 protocol, code, output, receipt, or report is modified or reclassified by this package.

dates.common_overlap_rule: For each symbol, use the intersection of exact Yahoo and Alpaca-all session dates between the later first date and earlier last date. For candidate comparisons, intersect exact dates across both sources and all 20 symbols. Never fill or interpolate a date.

yahoo_primary.snapshot: Exact hash-pinned Generation 4 private panel; no Yahoo redownload
yahoo_primary.semantics: Stored adjusted-close values from the Generation 4 panel. The provider adjustment formula is not independently reconstructed.

alpaca_all_primary.semantics: Alpaca documents all as forward/reverse split, cash-dividend, and spin-off adjustment. IEX is Investors Exchange, a single-exchange feed.
alpaca_all_primary.role: Primary per-symbol and candidate price/return/signal concordance series.

alpaca_split_diagnostic.semantics: Alpaca documents split as forward/reverse split adjustment.
alpaca_split_diagnostic.role: Diagnostic only. Split/all differences are not classified as corporate-action dates, are not a pass gate, and never exclude an observation from the primary comparison.

alignment_and_null_policy.timezone: UTC calendar date derived from each provider timestamp; Alpaca daily IEX bars are normalized to YYYY-MM-DD and the stored Yahoo panel already uses YYYY-MM-DD.
alignment_and_null_policy.chronology: Every source/symbol series must be strictly increasing with unique dates and finite positive closes; a violation fails closed.
alignment_and_null_policy.alignment: Inner join exact dates only. Never forward-fill, backward-fill, interpolate, splice providers, or substitute a missing value.
alignment_and_null_policy.return_definition: Natural log of close_t divided by close_t-1 on adjacent dates in the exact aligned common-date sequence.
alignment_and_null_policy.tracking_error: Sample standard deviation of paired daily log-return differences multiplied by sqrt(252).
alignment_and_null_policy.annualized_mean_difference: Absolute mean paired daily log-return difference multiplied by 252 and 10,000 basis points.
alignment_and_null_policy.no_exclusions: Every primary common-date return enters the metrics. Alpaca all-versus-split differences remove zero observations.

per_symbol_decision_rule.risky_etfs: Every symbol other than BIL must pass the common-session, Yahoo-coverage, correlation, tracking-error, median-gap, and p99-gap gates against Alpaca IEX adjustment=all.
per_symbol_decision_rule.bil: BIL must pass the common-session and Yahoo-coverage gates plus annualized absolute mean-log-return difference, tracking error, median gap, and p99 gap. Correlation is deliberately not a BIL gate because a near-zero rounded series can make correlation unstable or undefined.

candidate_comparison.scope: Every Generation 5 strategy whose frozen metadata has role=candidate and eligible=true.
candidate_comparison.panel: Exact fully common Yahoo/Alpaca-all panel across all 20 CORE_SYMBOLS.
candidate_comparison.decision_schedule: Use the real Generation 5 strategy objects and the corrected queued execution engine. Wrap each source-specific strategy instance to record each actual decide() call without changing its state or observe() sequence.
candidate_comparison.exact_decision_definition: Compare the full CORE_SYMBOLS weight vector after the engine's canonical ten-decimal rounding. The signal date and canonical vector must match.
candidate_comparison.return_definition: Compare aligned daily log(1 + modeled net return) under the same costs and execution assumptions.
candidate_comparison.edge_definition: For each source separately, annualized candidate log growth minus annualized SPY log growth over the common candidate panel.
candidate_comparison.same_sign_rule: The Yahoo and Alpaca-all candidate-minus-SPY annualized log-growth edges must have exactly the same mathematical sign; there is no neutral-zone exception.

overall_decision_rule.pass: PASS_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION only when all 20 per-symbol primary comparisons and every eligible Generation 5 candidate comparison pass every applicable gate.
overall_decision_rule.fail: Any missing source, malformed response, chronology or pagination failure, frozen-hash mismatch, threshold failure, candidate-registry mismatch, incomplete run, or credential error produces FAIL_CLOSED. No candidate-level success can override a symbol failure.
overall_decision_rule.promotion_boundary: This package supplies only a source-concordance prerequisite. It cannot rescue a failed Generation 4 result, replace Generation 5 selection/robustness gates, or authorize a champion by itself.

security.credentials: Read only from ignored local environment variables and transmit only as Alpaca authentication headers to the fixed data.alpaca.markets endpoint.
security.persistence: Never persist credentials, authentication headers, raw response bodies, or page tokens. Persist only content hashes, aggregate metrics, dates, gate results, and source metadata.
security.network: Exactly two authenticated read-only paginated GET families are permitted: IEX adjustment=all primary and IEX adjustment=split diagnostic for the frozen 20-symbol/date request.
